title: The dock headers match the mock: small caps title, a count chip and a panel menu
goal: Every group in the panel on a video should have the header the video mock draws: a small caps title, a pill beside it saying what it holds, and a three dot menu, instead of the app's title case heading and grip.
notes: Found in the side by side for the-properties-pane-opens-on-the-clip-line-and-l (queue/audits/2026-09-25-properties-pane-side-by-side.png). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html .dgrp-h (.ttl uppercase letter-spaced, .cnt pill, .btn ghost icon ic-more). App: the dock section header in InspectorPanel/InspectorDockLayout draws the title and a grip (≡). The Properties kind pill already exists (PropertyKeysSectionAccessory) and Library shows its scope as plain text. This is the whole dock, so check the image lens too.
acceptance: On a video, each panel group header shows a small caps title, its chip and a three dot menu, as video.html .dgrp-h draws it
The Properties, Library and Effects chips read Title/Clip/Audio, the Library scope, and the effect count
A walk at Next defaults photographs the headers beside the mock
Pictures (no time) are either unchanged or changed on purpose, said in the audit

log.note: triage 2026-09-25: goal reworded without the mock's file name.

review before building: the mock draws a DIFFERENT trailing control per group (Properties ⋯, Effects +, Library +, Graph none), so only Properties gains a menu; Effects and Library keep their existing plus. The mock's #propMenu holds Copy properties and Reset to defaults: Copy Look/Paste Look already exist (Layer menu, right click) and work on a clip, so the menu uses them under their app names; Reset has no action in the app, filed as the-properties-menu-puts-a-clip-back-the-way-it (p1). The header is shared with Current, so the look is behind a new Next-only flag next-dock-headers, on by default; the image lens takes it too because every image mock draws the same .dgrp-h.

built: DockGroupHeader (PhotonzCore, tested in DockGroupHeaderTests) for title caps, tracking and chip rules; CollapsibleSection draws the mock row (chevron, 10pt semibold faint caps with .09em tracking, chip, spacer, buttons, no grip; ink on hover) with the flag on and the old row with it off; InspectorPanel.sectionChip gives Properties Kind, Library Scope, Effects Count, Measurements Count; PropertiesPanelMenu in PropertyKeysInspector.swift. New walk Scripts/playtest/dock-headers-walk.json (front: true, since the clip press needs the probe in front, the same as properties-pane-walk).

left rough: the mock's header buttons sit on a faint round ghost backing and the app draws the bare glyph; a small visual nit, not filed. The image mock's Layers heading has a count chip and a ⋯ menu the image panel lacks; image-editing is a later epic, so not filed. Graph group: covered by a-keyed-value-s-curve-opens-where-you-want-it.

Next dock headings are the mock's .dgrp-h behind next-dock-headers (on by default): small caps title, chip beside it (Properties Clip/Title/Audio, Library scope, Effects and Measurements counts), buttons at the far edge, no grip; Properties ends in a ⋯ menu with Copy Look and Paste Look. Pictures change on purpose (same headings). Verified: DockGroupHeaderTests + full suite green (10,065), dock-headers-walk and 8 related walks green at Next defaults with real captures, side by side in the audit. Reset to defaults filed as the-properties-menu-puts-a-clip-back-the-way-it.
